

![][image1]

Tim Gu is a Canadian investor, operator, and chairman with extensive experience across consumer brands, retail, apparel manufacturing, and commercial real estate. He is the Chairman of Smart Investments Holding, a private investment platform focused on acquiring, building, and growing businesses and real assets with long-term value creation potential.

In the public markets, Tim serves as Executive Chairman of Unisync Corp. (TSX: UNI), a leading North American provider of managed uniform and apparel programs serving corporate clients, public sector organizations, and first responders. Through his leadership, Unisync continues to strengthen its position as an integrated apparel solutions provider with a focus on operational excellence and customer service.

Tim is also the owner of E.Star International Inc., a Toronto-based apparel manufacturing platform with Canadian production capabilities, more than 27 years of sourcing and import experience, and specialized expertise in complex garment manufacturing. E.Star has been a key supplier to Canada Goose and possesses the capabilities to support national defense and institutional uniform programs.

In the consumer and brand sector, Tim is Chairman and controlling owner of Mountain Equipment Company (MEC), a shareholder of Roots, and co-owner of Tilley. He focuses on unlocking value through operational discipline, supply chain excellence, strategic partnerships, and long-term brand development.

Through Smart Investments Holding, Tim also oversees a substantial commercial real estate portfolio comprising approximately 2.4 million square feet of industrial, commercial, and enclosed mall properties across Canada. His investment philosophy is centered on disciplined capital allocation, operational improvement, and creating sustainable long-term value for stakeholders.

![][image2]

Les Fluxgold Smart Investments Legal Advisor

Les Fluxgold is a respected legal and business advisor with extensive expertise in commercial real estate, commercial lending, and corporate transactions. He supports the Smart Investments team by providing practical legal guidance on complex acquisitions, financing arrangements, and other real estate matters.

Les previously served as counsel to the Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing and practised law privately for more than 20 years. He has also spent over 15 years representing many of Canada’s leading commercial lenders. His ability to identify key objectives, assess available options, and navigate transactions through to completion makes him a valued advisor to the Smart Investments team.

Known for his practical, solutions-oriented approach, Les provides strategic recommendations that reflect both the legal and commercial considerations of each transaction.

His areas of expertise include commercial real estate, commercial lending, corporate and commercial matters, and estate planning. Les earned his Juris Doctor from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1984 and was called to the Ontario Bar in 1987\.

Dannese Yang, CPA, MBA, is a seasoned finance and accounting professional with 15 years of experience spanning manufacturing, real estate, retail, wholesale distribution, and shared services. As Controller at Smart Investment Ltd., Dannese oversees financial reporting, treasury management, investor relations, corporate governance, and strategic financial planning across a diverse portfolio of commercial real estate and investment entities. Throughout her career, she has successfully led complex acquisitions, implemented operational improvements, strengthened financial controls, and delivered actionable insights that support long-term business growth.

A Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) and graduate of the Ivey Executive MBA program, Dannese is passionate about leadership, continuous improvement, and creating value through sound financial stewardship. She is recognized for her collaborative approach, commitment to excellence, and ability to bridge financial strategy with operational execution. Beyond finance, Dannese is dedicated to mentoring professionals, fostering high-performing teams, and contributing to the broader business community through thought leadership and professional engagement.

HR and Payroll Specialist

Anki is a versatile Financial Analyst with strong experience in financial reporting, AR/AP operations, and banking activities. Combining technical proficiency with a proactive mindset, Anki delivers clear insights that help organizations improve efficiency, strengthen financial stability, and achieve long-term growth.
